messages.content:
To use a tool, reply with exactly one block per call, in this form:
<tool_call>
{"name": "read", "arguments": {"path": "README.md"}}
</tool_call>
Stop after the block and wait. The result comes back inside a <tool_response> block.
Tools:
- probe_echo(word: string): echo one word back
Call the tool probe_echo with word "phycode". Do not answer in plain text.
